20.heading: Noah:
refs: Daniel, says Abp. Newcombe, was "taken captive in the third year of Jehoiakim - Dan 1:1 . After this, Jehoiakam reigned eight years - 2Ki 23:36 . And this prophecy, as appears from Eze 8:1 , was uttered in the sixth year of Jehoiachin's captivity, who succeeded Jehoiakim, and reigned only three months - 2Ki 24:6 , 8 . Therefore, at this time, Daniel had been fourteen years in captivity
" and was, as is generally supposed, about thirty years of age.
20.body:
Eze 14:14 , 16
Daniel:
Daniel, says Abp. Newcombe, was "taken captive in the third year of Jehoiakim - Dan 1:1 . After this, Jehoiakam reigned eight years - 2Ki 23:36 . And this prophecy, as appears from Eze 8:1 , was uttered in the sixth year of Jehoiachin's captivity, who succeeded Jehoiakim, and reigned only three months - 2Ki 24:6 , 8 . Therefore, at this time, Daniel had been fourteen years in captivity;" and was, as is generally supposed, about thirty years of age.
